summary.text: Craig Headland is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 29 since 2002 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Headland attended North Dakota State University and Moorhead State University, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as a farmer and, previously, as a machine operator.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as chair of the House Finance and Taxation Committee and membership on the House Agriculture Committee.
